title: Police Blotter: 10 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 10 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Nov. 8, 2026 — including alleged DWI, assault, theft, harassment, and federal and out-of-county holds. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Ten people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Sunday, November 8, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

SAENZ, RODOLFO, JR

SAENZ, RODOLFO, JR was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 1:26 a.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,500.

GUERRA, ALFREDO MAURICIO

GUERRA, ALFREDO MAURICIO was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 2:33 a.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at under $100 with a previous conviction, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

RODRIGUEZ, ARIEL VICTORIA

RODRIGUEZ, ARIEL VICTORIA was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 3:05 a.m. on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana under two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. She is also held on an out-of-county/state hold. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

QUIROZ, LESLIE MARICELA

QUIROZ, LESLIE MARICELA was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 4:25 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

ORTEGA TOVAR, DIANA GUADALUPE

ORTEGA TOVAR, DIANA GUADALUPE was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 4:20 a.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or more, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

LOPEZ-AGUILERA, RAFAEL

LOPEZ-AGUILERA, RAFAEL was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 6:53 a.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,500. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

CASTILLO, LEONEL

CASTILLO, LEONEL was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 10:59 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor, and unlawful carrying of a weapon, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set on either charge at the time of booking.

TOBIAS, LUIS

TOBIAS, LUIS was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 11:09 a.m. on an alleged charge of harassment, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

RAMOS-AROS, ANDRES

RAMOS-AROS, ANDRES was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 2:37 p.m. by the United States Marshals on an alleged charge of a federal violation. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. He is held by the United States Marshals.

ANGUIANO, RICARDO

ANGUIANO, RICARDO was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 10:41 p.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
